literal_meaning: হাত দিয়ে গোনা যায় এমন (countable by hand)
figurative_meaning_en: a small number, just a few
similar_in_english: can be counted on one hand
example_sentences_in_bangla: সভায় হাতে গোনা মাত্র লোক উপস্থিত ছিল।
তার কাছে হাতে গোনা কয়েকটা বই আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Only a handful of people were present at the meeting.
He has just a few books with him.
note: This idiom reflects everyday Bengali expression for scarcity in numbers, emphasizing simplicity in counting.
